_meta.intent: Balanced gold set for Metatake ASK (grounded RAG over film close-readings). expected.films / expected.themes are approximate relevance HINTS for the retrieval hit-proxy, grounded in film-criticism domain knowledge and a read-only sample of the live corpus (kyniq). They are NOT a strict relevance judgment set and WILL be refined once the 1500-film import + embedding stabilizes. Do NOT freeze a comparison baseline against these numbers until the corpus stops moving.
_meta.item_schema: { id, question, lang, type, expected: { films?: string[], themes?: string[] }, should_refuse: bool, notes }
